source: Barreiro-Hurle et al. (2021), 'Modelling environmental and climate ambition in the agricultural sector with the CAPRI model', JRC121368, EUR 30317 EN, doi:10.2760/98160
why_this_matters: Published CAPRI Green Deal scenario results. Lets us validate policy-scenario response WITHOUT running CAPRI - the same route used successfully for the MACC against EcAMPA 2.

pesticides_50pct.capri_method: 50% reduction in EXPENDITURE on plant protection products (CAPRI models PPP through cost, not quantity)
accompanying_shocks: 50% increase in other costs (mechanical weeding, alternative practices)
10% average annual yield loss, applied to cereals, oilseeds, vegetables, other arable and permanent crops
pesticides_50pct.yield_loss_basis: Sanchez et al. (2019) review: 18.6% of EU production potentially affected by 20 pests; worst case of 50% production loss on that share
pesticides_50pct.note: CAPRI has NO dose-response function for PPP (unlike fertiliser) - the 10% yield loss is an explicit ASSUMPTION, stated as such

nutrient_surplus.capri_method: binding restriction on gross nitrogen balance (GNB) per region, with N mitigation technologies available
nutrient_surplus.tiered_reduction: 25% on the first 50 kg/ha of GNB; 50% for 50-100; 75% for 100-150; 100% above 150
nutrient_surplus.worked_example: a region at 50 kg/ha GNB targets 37.5; a region at 100 kg/ha targets 62.5
nutrient_surplus.note: phosphorus and potassium NOT modelled - CAPRI has no P/K balance system

organic_25pct.capri_method: constraints plus I/O parameter adjustment on the representative regional farm
shocks: zero mineral fertiliser use (max threshold by crop group: vegetables, permanent, other)
100% reduction in plant protection product use
lower crop yields reflecting the organic yield gap (FADN-based)
organic_25pct.spatial_level: EU-level target, allocated to regions by distance to target
organic_25pct.note: no adjustment for the higher market value of organic output - a stated model limitation

landscape_features_10pct.capri_method: minimum SET-ASIDE area constraint - 'landscape elements are not included in the model'
landscape_features_10pct.implementation: increased FALLOW area, zero cost and zero production
landscape_features_10pct.spatial_level: regional, homogeneous within MS based on MS distance to target

capri_own_caveats: not a formal impact assessment; results are 'a first rough indicative estimate'
impacts on production can be OVERESTIMATED - positive co-benefits of the targets are not modelled
assumes the EU acts alone, so a significant part of EU emission gains leaks to other world regions
demand side not covered: no food waste reduction, no dietary shift, no organic action plan
'the magnitude of the specific findings on activity levels, trade flows, income and environmental indicators should not be taken as definitive in absolute terms'
